rows.name: the core rule, no shorts, paper only
rows.question: Three short things: when buying turns on, what share of the 500 dollar book goes to Bitcoin and to Ethereum, and is it bought at once or in steps? Can the book sell short or bet on a fall? Do you place real orders on NDAX with my money?
rows.answer: Good evening, sir. When the dial opens, the core buys Bitcoin 40% and Ethereum 20% of the book, all at once. That's the all-in rule since 10 Nov, and the thirds of 24 Oct are switched off. No, the book can't sell short or bet on a fall. It's buying only, and when the dial closes it sells everything and sits in cash. And no, I don't place real orders: it's paper only, with no exchange connected and live trading locked until your live rules are approved. Right now the dial is closed, so the account is all cash, C$467.55, down about 6.5% from C$500.
